verdict.rationale: cubic documents a public Analytics API for PR-level data (cubic-docs-16) and a documented MCP server that lets an agent request PR reviews, read findings, triage issues, and even manage subscriptions/seats (cubic-docs-8, cubic-docs-15, cubic-probe-4, cubic-probe-rt-1), plus a CLI for local review (cubic-probe-5, cubic-probe-rt-2) — all agent-drivable surfaces. However, probing found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all candidate paths 404, cubic-probe-3), so there's no single comprehensive documented REST API, only narrower purpose-built endpoints/protocols. Missing for 10: a full OpenAPI/swagger-documented REST API covering broader product control, and independent third-party confirmation of API usage beyond docs/probes.
